event.title: Chris Van Hollen Announces Challenge to Chuck Schumer for Senate Majority Leader
event.canonical_title: Chris Van Hollen Announces Challenge to Chuck Schumer for Senate Majority Leader
event.summary: Senator Chris Van Hollen of Maryland has declared his intention to challenge Senator Chuck Schumer for the position of Senate Majority Leader in the upcoming Congress. This announcement follows the Democratic Party's success in the recent midterm elections, with Van Hollen responding to calls for new leadership within the party. Schumer, currently the Senate Minority Leader, is expected to defend his position.

timeline.title: Chris Van Hollen Announces Challenge to Chuck Schumer for Senate Majority Leader
timeline.summary: Maryland Senator Chris Van Hollen has declared his intention to challenge New York Senator Chuck Schumer for the position of Senate majority leader in the upcoming Congress. This marks the first significant challenge to Schumer's leadership, with Van Hollen receiving backing from some progressive members of the Democratic Party. Schumer, however, maintains that he has sufficient support to retain his leadership role.
key_facts: Chris Van Hollen is challenging Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader.
Van Hollen has support from some progressive Democrats.
This is the first serious challenge Schumer has faced for his leadership.
